crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: High-contrast alternating black and white horizontal bands forming a rectangular footprint on the posterior head and neck
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct linear transition boundary separating the striped nape from the uniform dark grey mantle

other_distinctive_markers: Visible reddish-orange patch of plumage on the lower right lateral flank at the base of the tail
